titulo: From the cradle to the grave
intro: The stages of life, from pregnancy and birth to old age, in neutral and in careful language.
p.embarazo.consejo: It comes from «embarazada», expecting a baby. It never means «embarrassed».
p.dar a luz.consejo: The baby «nace»; the mother «da a luz». It is a fixed expression.
p.parto.consejo: The mother «da a luz» and that moment is «el parto».
p.adolescencia.consejo: «Adolescente» works for boys and girls: «un adolescente», «una adolescente».
p.madurez.consejo: It comes from «maduro», also said of fruit: «un plátano maduro».
p.vejez.consejo: It comes from «viejo». With people «mayor» is preferred: «las personas mayores».
p.madurar.consejo: It is said of people and fruit: «madurar» and «una fruta madura».
p.envejecer.consejo: Like other verbs in «-ecer», the «yo» form takes «zc»: «envejezco».
p.hacerse mayor.glosa: to grow up; to get old
p.hacerse mayor.consejo: With «hacerse» the change is slow: «me hago mayor». «De mayor» is «when I grow up».
p.esperanza de vida.consejo: You say «la esperanza de vida al nacer». In Spain it is over eighty years.
p.fallecer.consejo: It is the formal verb for «morir», typical in the news. In «yo»: «fallezco».
p.entierro.consejo: It comes from «enterrar»: the «e» becomes «ie» in «entierro».
p.maternidad.consejo: It is also the leave from work: «la baja por maternidad». For fathers, «paternidad».
b1.texto:
**Before and at birth.** **Quedarse embarazada**, **el embarazo**, **dar a luz**, **el parto**. **La maternidad** and **la paternidad** are both the condition and the leave from work.

**The ages.** Each has a noun and a person:

- **la niñez** or **la infancia**: un niño
- **la adolescencia**: un adolescente
- **la juventud**: un joven
- **la madurez**: una persona madura
- **la vejez** or **la tercera edad**: una persona mayor

Spanish avoids **viejo** for people. **Mayor** is the polite word: **las personas mayores**.

**Verbs of change.** **Crecer**, **madurar**, **hacerse mayor**, **envejecer**, **jubilarse**. Many end in **-ecer** and take **-zc-** in «yo»: **envejezco**, **crezco**.

**Death.** The neutral verb is **morir**. In the news and in formal speech it is **fallecer** (**el fallecimiento**). Afterwards comes **el entierro**.

**Useful phrases.** **A los veinte años** he left home. **De joven** he lived in Paris. **De mayor** she wants to be a doctor. **Con el paso de los años**…
b2.f1.texto: It was a simple childhood in a mountain village.
b2.f2.texto: Tell me something about your adolescence.
b2.f3.texto: At sixteen I was already working in a factory.
b2.f4.texto: Then you grew up very early.
b2.f5.texto: Today I am glad I matured early.
b2.f6.texto: They say life expectancy is now over eighty years.
b2.f7.texto: I want to grow old healthy and in my own home.
b4.texto:
**Verbs in -ecer**: the «yo» form takes **-zc-**. **Envejecer** → **envejezco**; **fallecer** → **fallezco**; **crecer** → **crezco**.

**De + adjective** tells the stage of life: **de joven**, **de mayor**, **de niña**.

**A los veinte años** gives the age. **Con el paso de los años** gives passing time.

**Sin que** + subjunctive when the subject changes: **sin que nadie la viera**. If the subject is the same, **sin** + infinitive: **sin hacer ruido**.
b4.e0.texto: When she grows up she wants to be a vet.
b4.e1.texto: Every day I grow a little older.
b4.e2.texto: My grandmother went out without anyone seeing her.
b5.f0.texto: In the first photograph of the album, my grandmother is a baby wrapped in a white blanket.
b5.f1.texto: Then a barefoot girl appears with knees dirty with soil.
b5.f2.texto: In her adolescence she smiles shyly and glances sideways at the camera.
b5.f3.texto: In another photo she holds my mother in her arms with the strong hands of maturity.
b5.f4.texto: The years pass over her face like the wind passes over a field of wheat.
b5.f5.texto: In the last photos my grandmother is already an older woman with white hair.
b5.f6.texto: Old age has given her a new calm and a smile of deep wrinkles.
b5.f7.texto: Her hands, strong from so much work, now tremble a little as they hold the cup.
b5.f8.texto: When I ask her about her life, she closes her eyes and smiles without saying anything.
b5.f9.texto: As I close the album, I feel that each age is still alive inside her.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «fallecer» is the formal verb for «morir».
b6.o1.refuerzo: Envejecer is growing old, not dying.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Madurar is growing up or ripening.
b6.pregunta: Which word does a newspaper use for «murió»?
b7.o1.refuerzo: The «z» is missing: the «yo» form takes «zc».
b7.o2.refuerzo: The «c» is missing: the right form is «envejezco».
b8.traduccion: When she grows up she wants to be a vet
b9.o0.refuerzo: It is understood, but it sounds unkind.
b9.o2.refuerzo: «Antiguo» is said of things, not people.
b9.pregunta: How do you speak politely about elderly people?
b10.frase: Se fue sin que nadie la ____.
b10.o1.refuerzo: It is indicative, and after «sin que» comes the subjunctive.
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Sin que» needs a conjugated verb, not the infinitive.
b10.pregunta: Choose the verb that follows «sin que».
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it is a false friend of «embarrassed».
b12.o2.refuerzo: That would be «confundida», a different word.
p.sencilla.consejo: It is the feminine of «sencillo». The «c» sounds «th» and the «ll» sounds «y».
p.cuéntame.consejo: «Cuenta» plus «me»: an order for «tú». The accent keeps the stress on «cuén».
p.alegro.consejo: «Alegrarse de» something is feeling joy about it: «me alegro de verte».
p.haber.consejo: The «h» is silent. With a participle it forms compound tenses: «he comido».
p.madurado.consejo: It is the participle of «madurar». With «haber»: «ha madurado».
p.dicen.consejo: It is the «ellos» form of «decir». The «c» sounds «th» before «e».
p.supera.consejo: «Superar» is going past a limit or going further.
p.ochenta.consejo: The «ch» sounds as in «chocolate». It is written as one word.
p.envejezco.consejo: A verb in «-ecer»: in «yo» it takes «zc». The «j» sounds like a strong h.
p.salió.consejo: The accent marks the last syllable. «Salir de» a place is leaving it.
p.viera.consejo: Imperfect subjunctive of «ver». It follows «sin que»: «sin que nadie la viera».
p.fotografía.consejo: It is shortened to «foto». The accent on the «í» breaks the diphthong.
p.álbum.consejo: The accent marks the first syllable. The plural is «álbumes».
p.bebé.consejo: The accent marks the last syllable. It works for a boy or a girl: «el bebé».
p.envuelto.consejo: It is the irregular participle of «envolver». It agrees: «envuelto», «envuelta».
p.aparece.consejo: «Aparecer» is a verb in «-ecer»: «aparezco», «aparece». The «c» sounds «th».
p.descalza.consejo: It is the feminine of «descalzo». The «z» sounds «th» in Spain.
p.sucias.consejo: Feminine plural of «sucio». The «c» sounds «th» before «i».
p.cámara.consejo: The accent marks the first syllable, because the word stresses the third-from-last: «CÁ-ma-ra».
p.fuertes.consejo: It is the same for masculine and feminine. The «ue» is a diphthong: «FWER-tes».
p.pasan.consejo: «Pasar por» is crossing a place: «los años pasan por su cara».
p.últimas.consejo: The accent marks the first syllable: «ÚL-ti-mas». The singular is «última».
p.fotos.consejo: «Foto» is feminine even though it ends in «-o»: «la foto». It is short for «fotografía».
p.profundas.consejo: The singular is «profunda». The opposite is «superficial».
p.pregunto.consejo: «Preguntar por» something or someone is wanting to know about it: «le pregunto por su vida».
p.edad.consejo: It ends in «-d» and is feminine: «la edad». The plural is «edades».
p.viva.consejo: It is the feminine of «vivo». The «v» sounds «b» both times.
p.falleció.consejo: The accent marks the last syllable. It is the formal past of «morir».
